'''Uncle Fu''' is an NPC in {{Location|Hongzhen}}.

==Profile==
He was the former Mayor of [[Hongzhen]], a city in [[Mt. Firmament]], prior to [[Xinyi]]. At one hundred years old, he is said to be the oldest person in Mt. Firmament.

He owned the [[Scale of Memories]] before giving it to [[Rover]].
